thread:
jen: Quick async check — Claymore on-prem cutover readiness. Can owners call out blockers for network / air-gap / certs? I want a short snapshot (1-2 lines each) so I can update the customer tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

omar: I can own egress/firewall. Last I saw, egress NAT is ready but security wants explicit NTP+CRL egress allowed. I'll validate rules with infra team today.

mike: I will validate image sync + registry certs. FYI image sync failed once with checksum mismatch, but fixed after retry. Planning one more full sync tonight.

sara: I'll take the preflight tests and smoke canary once sync is done. Do we have the exact test list?

jen: thanks. quick owners map: @omar (egress/fw), @mike (images/certs), @sara (smoke/tests). ops-bot, can you post the current artifact bundle id? :robot_face:

ops-bot: artifact-bundle: claymore-2026-03-01-rc5 (size: 3.8GB) — last sync: 2026-03-01T22:12Z

omar: small blocker: security wants outbound to 3 IP ranges for OCSP/CRL — ranges below. Need confirmation that Claymore ops team accepts these CIDRs.

```
OCSP/CRL egress (proposed):
- 198.51.100.10/32
- 203.0.113.0/24
- 192.0.2.128/25
```

mike: noted. registry cert: claymore-registry.internal uses CN=registry.claymore.local. We need the CA chain installed on the air-gapped hosts. I pushed CA bundle to /mnt/artifacts/ca/rc5.pem during the sync. Command I ran:

```
aws s3 sync s3://redwood-artifacts/claymore /mnt/artifacts --exact-timestamps
sha256sum /mnt/artifacts/* | grep rc5
```

sara: test list (short):
- bootstrap healthcheck (api / healthz)
- model load smoke (small model)
- kv cache warmup + latency obs
- egress CRL check + NTP offset < 200ms
Please confirm owners for each.

omar: I own the egress CRL check + firewall rule verification. Will ping security for CIDR approval today, ETA EOD.

mike: I own registry cert install and image integrity. Will run a checksum sweep after tonight's sync.

sara: I'll run the smoke tests once both done. ETA tomorrow AM.

jen: two practical asks: (1) if any CIDR or cert item is blocked by legal/security, drop a 1-line note here, (2) paste any failing logs as snippets, not attachments.

mike: small log from last sync (checksum mismatch):
```
ERROR: checksum mismatch for claymore-runtime.tar.gz expected 1a2b3c got 4d5e6f
Retrying... success on attempt 2
```

omar: security update: need CRL OCSP permission from Claymore's network team for 198.51.100.10/32. I sent mail to claymore-net@claymore.health. Waiting reply, pinged them in their slack.

sara: blocker watch — if image sync doesn't finish tonight, we should hold the canary. I'll mark "blocked" in the deployment sheet.

jen: thanks all. I'll email the customer with this snapshot later and call out owners + ETA. If anything changes, please update this thread. :thumbsup:"
